rows.add: Its three TRY suggestions are page-wide jobs run against whatever scope is active: each must set its own scope when clicked and say so in the band, or be hidden when the scope cannot serve it (UX-G-19).
rows.why: UX-G-19 — the panel's three starter prompts run against whatever scope happens to be active and the panel never warns when suggestion and scope disagree. The rule is on board B (2846:21567); this puts it on the caption of the board that draws the suggestions. Caption 172:33 read 2026-09-07 at @100,1052 280x54; the next row starts at y=1226, so 174px of gap — maxHeight 150 keeps a gutter and refuses rather than laying the caption across board 2476:12001.

rows.name: hotspot/AI · in-canvas popover
rows.why: UX-G-11 (outside this pass's eighteen, carried because the pass measured it): board 2476:12001 'AI · in-canvas popover — 4 states' re-read 2026-09-07 with rx=0 — no node in the file reaches it. 2846:21471 is board A's decision cell for the canvas-toolbar door, whose text names that popover ('the popover shares the panel's state machine (UX-G-11)'). Wiring the row to the board it names gives the popover its first inbound edge without inventing a product flow.
